feasibility.eligible: finite iterate with scaled constraint violation <= 1e-5

objective.definition: running squared normalized tip error and qdot; squared tension and tension variation; terminal squared normalized tip error and qdot; configured speed weights are zero
objective.selection_comparison: strictly lower objective replaces a retained callback candidate; the first callback candidate may replace the synthetic initialization on equality

early_stop.mapped_status: feasible_early_stop when callback requested a stop and selected violation <= 1e-5

recovery: disabled in both executions; no returned-tension reintegration can replace callback selection
fallback: an unusable solve holds the last bounded command, but every studied update was accepted and no fallback was used

field_meanings.initialization_selected: report count where optimization_selected_iteration is -1 or 0
field_meanings.feasible_early_stop: accepted independently feasible candidate after intentional callback stop; not convergence
field_meanings.User_Requested_Stop: raw IPOPT termination caused by callback policy
field_meanings.converged_updates: count of optimization_status == converged; zero does not mean zero accepted plans
